profile.name: Reza Ghamar
profile.title: Mobile & Full-Stack Developer
profile.bio: Self-taught developer from Ahvaz, Iran, shipping production apps end-to-end: native Android (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose), React Native, and web frontends backed by Django REST APIs — including billing, OTP auth, and deployment.

projects.name: Mangaro
projects.tagline: Persian-first, self-hosted manga reader for the Iranian market
projects.description: Curated manga platform built end-to-end: native Android app (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose, heavily refactored TachiyomiSY fork) talking to a single self-hosted Django REST backend. Phone-OTP auth, Free/Plus subscriptions via Zarinpal, RTL-locked Persian UI, and a sanctioned deploy pipeline to production on Liara.
highlights: Production system end-to-end: mobile app, API, billing, media proxy, CI, deploy scripts
Large-scale fork surgery — replacing upstream Tachiyomi systems with custom auth, source, and onboarding flows
Offline-first: local SQLDelight database is authoritative, backend mirrors it
projects.repoNote: Private repository — code available on request

projects.name: Zaboon
projects.tagline: Gamified English-learning app for Persian speakers
projects.description: Game-like language learning app built with React Native (Expo) and TypeScript, backed by a custom Python API. Quiz progression, leaderboards, alphabet training, Lottie-animated loading flows, over-the-air updates, and full RTL handling.
highlights: Second mobile stack alongside native Kotlin — React Native + Expo with OTA updates
Persian-first UX: RTL layout, localized game flows
Custom Python backend (ZaboonAPI) for content and progress
projects.repoNote: Private repository — code available on request

projects.name: Profit App
projects.tagline: Production fintech-style mobile app, built with a team
projects.description: Shipped, versioned production app (React Native + Expo, TypeScript) developed collaboratively — part of a product family including an admin app and web frontends. Contributed across the main mobile client through tagged releases.
highlights: Team collaboration on a real release cycle (tagged versions, multi-app product family)
Large TypeScript codebase with shared components across apps

projects.name: Evently
projects.description: Event discovery and management platform built with Next.js and TypeScript, deployed on Vercel. Create, browse, and manage events through a server-rendered React frontend.

projects.name: Basic ETH Wallet
projects.description: Solidity smart contract wallet with guardian-based ownership recovery (3-guardian multi-sig owner change), per-address spending allowances, and safe ETH transfers using call() with reentrancy protection.
highlights: Guardian recovery system — no single point of failure
Modern Solidity patterns (0.8.x, call() over deprecated transfer())
Spending allowances for delegated, capped access

androidSection.description: Mangaro is a heavily reworked TachiyomiSY fork — Kotlin, Compose, offline-first reading, OTP auth and subscription billing running in production. Zaboon brings gamified English lessons to Persian speakers.

resume.summary: Self-taught developer with several years of freelance experience. Started in frontend web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js — both CSR and SSR), then expanded into mobile: native Android with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, and cross-platform apps with React Native/Expo. Now building complete products end-to-end — mobile clients, Django REST backends, payment integration, and production deployment.

points: Building Mangaro: Persian-first manga platform — Kotlin/Compose Android app + Django REST backend in production
Frontend development with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Bootstrap
Cross-platform mobile apps with React Native and Expo (Zaboon, Profit App team)
Banner design and visual identity work with Adobe Photoshop
